watch.name: Radisson
watch.what: Hotel group launching its first paid membership, aimed at local diners rather than hotel guests.
watch.why_fit: A locals-focused dining membership opens a partnership angle beyond traveler perks, such as card-linked dining access or discounts.

history.note: Skift reports Radisson is launching a paid membership targeting diners with generous discounts.

items.title: Radisson’s First Paid Membership Targets Diners, Not Guests: Exclusive
items.why: Paid hotel memberships aimed at locals open a partnership angle beyond traveler-focused perks.
items.summary_ai: Radisson is launching a paid membership aimed at local diners rather than frequent travelers, with generous discounts.
items.take: Paid hotel memberships aimed at locals open a partnership angle beyond traveler-focused perks.
